name: Documentation maintenance
description: Check canonical AI and product documentation for drift from the current code and version.

task_source.prompt: Inspect AGENTS.md, docs/ai/context.md, docs/ai/next-development-plan.md, docs/roadmap.md, and CHANGELOG.md. Compare their version, completed capabilities, known boundaries, and next milestone with the current code. Report concrete drift and bounded documentation fixes. Do not commit, push, open a pull request, merge, deploy, or change non-documentation files.
